expected: Barbed Barrage offers its optional {r}{r}{r} additional cost; when it is paid, the attack has an additional target, so with no defenders it deals 5 damage to the opposing hero and destroys an opposing 3-life ally.
testName: Barbed Barrage paid with its additional cost attacks the hero and an opposing ally

expected: When Dense Blue Mist is played with a Chi pitched, effects don't trigger when an attack hits its controller for the rest of the turn, so an opposing Snatch that hits does not draw a card.
testName: Dense Blue Mist paid with a Chi stops hit effects of attacks that hit you this turn

expected: After Surgent Aethertide deals 1 arcane damage, the first card its controller plays that turn with an arcane damage effect deals that much plus 1, so Swell Tidings deals 6.
testName: Surgent Aethertide adds its damage to the first arcane damage card played that turn

expected: After The Old Switcheroo is activated targeting a hero, the controller's next clash with that hero that turn instead reveals the top card of that hero's deck for the controller and the controller's top card for them; if the controller wins, that hero discards a card.
testName: The Old Switcheroo swaps the revealed decks for its controller's next clash
